pages.title: Block of Cosmic Neutronium
pages.text: Nine ingots of cosmic neutronium fused into a block denser than the inside of a neutron star. It is hard to pick up and harder to put down gently. It casts a faint, cold shadow even in full light. A few faint points of light swim deep inside it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cosmic neutronium was too precious to leave loose. Pressing it into a block was easy; moving the block afterwards was not, but the supply is safe.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Cosmic Neutronium Ingot, Singularity Energy Cell, Transcendent Cache.
